theme: The last day on land before two weeks away.
greeting: Departure day, Dan. The St. Pete stay closes out this morning and you fly to Frankfurt tonight, Dubrovnik tomorrow, then a week of sailing. Anything that has to be booked from dry land closes with today's signal.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags, Basic Economy on Eurowings Discover. Verify the allowance on the operating carrier's site and buy bags online before tonight's counter, where two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on. Travel, p1, overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat night and the transfer
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends noon Sat Sept 19 at ACI Komolac. You need a refundable Cavtat room, a pre-booked Komolac to Cavtat transfer, and the ~5 AM airport run for the Sept 20 flight, all set before you board since charter signal is poor. Travel, p1, overdue since Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: Close the Sept 20 to 22 St. Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20 but the kids aren't picked up until Tue the 22nd, and those two nights are still unbooked. Worth a glance that the pending Sept 27 to Oct 5 Airbnb converted from PENDING to confirmed. Travel, p1.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding time with the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: The contact is in hand; still owed is confirming Saturday's boarding time and location and arranging the return airport transfer. Easier to settle now than once you're underway with less bandwidth. Travel, p2, due Sept 5.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The call was due Sept 5, and the Oct 18 to Nov 1 rental books itself while you're offline. Decide before you lose signal so the downstream bookings move with the answer rather than after it. Travel, p2.

schedule.title: Flight to Frankfurt
schedule.detail: UA9661 TPA to FRA, connecting to Dubrovnik tomorrow morning

inbox.noise: Three unread, all promotional or transactional: a campaign donation ask, a gadget pitch, and the closed St. Pete Airbnb thread.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply.

context.location: St. Petersburg, FL (flying to Croatia tonight)

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Autumn's first hard squash meets smoke and sweetness over fresh noodles.

tasks.title: Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos before the course
Hold the refundable Sept 20 to Oct 5 backup car unless Mike's car is confirmed en route

acts.line: The St. Pete house checked out at 10 and the rental goes back at TPA around noon, so the day's logistics land well before the flight.
An open stretch until the airport run, the last window with real signal before the boat.
Wheels up for Frankfurt at 5:55, Dubrovnik in the morning, and a week of sailing after that.
